title: Agentic AI Engineer
summary: Designs, evaluates, and operates bounded model-directed systems that act through tools while preserving state, authority, evidence, recovery, and named professional boundaries.

includes: Agent suitability, goal and action contracts, harnesses, tools, state, handoffs, durable effects, evaluation, controls, operations, and change evidence
Application-level identity, delegated authority, approval, recovery, trace, release, and interoperability semantics
excludes: Broad AI product selection, model training, customer engagement, shared platform ownership, and enterprise architecture
Formal security, safety, privacy, legal, domain, financial, clinical, or physical-world risk authorization

competencies.title: Agent suitability and action contracts
competencies.description: Selects justified autonomy and contracts goals, actions, consequences, limits, and authority.

objectives.statement: Choose the least complex adequate execution model and specify observable completion, effects, authority, budgets, stop, and escalation.

competencies.title: Loop, harness, and run-state engineering
competencies.description: Builds explicit inspectable loops with deterministic enforcement around model choice.

objectives.statement: Implement replayable run transitions, cancellation, completion checks, and deterministic enforcement.

competencies.title: Tools and capability interfaces
competencies.description: Designs narrow typed capabilities with effect, error, idempotency, and test semantics.

objectives.statement: Expose bounded capabilities and handle validation, ambiguity, duplicate effects, and compensation limits.

competencies.title: State, context, artifacts, and memory
competencies.description: Separates workflow truth, model context, scratch state, durable artifacts, and derived memory.

objectives.statement: Apply provenance, freshness, permission, isolation, retention, and deletion to every state class.

competencies.title: Identity, authorization, delegation, and consent
competencies.description: Binds principals, agents, tasks, scopes, approvals, expiry, revocation, and audit evidence.

objectives.statement: Enforce least privilege and bind exact effects to valid delegated authority without credential leakage.

competencies.title: Orchestration, handoffs, and multi-agent coordination
competencies.description: Adds routing or multiple agents only when controlled evidence justifies coordination cost.

objectives.statement: Transfer task ownership, state, authority, evidence, cancellation, and completion through explicit handoff contracts.

competencies.title: Durable execution, effects, and recovery
competencies.description: Preserves accountable state and effects across retries, crashes, duplicates, and deployment change.

objectives.statement: Classify failure and choose retry, resume, reconcile, compensate, escalate, or stop with one final disposition.

competencies.title: Agent-system evaluation
competencies.description: Evaluates tasks, trajectories, state, actions, effects, controls, recovery, and efficiency.

objectives.statement: Produce versioned system-specific release evidence with representative tasks, segments, uncertainty, and limitations.

competencies.title: Security controls and human authority
competencies.description: Implements agent controls while preserving formal specialist and human decision rights.

objectives.statement: Map threats and faults to independently enforced controls, tests, residual limits, owners, and escalation.

competencies.title: Observability, performance, and AgentOps
competencies.description: Makes runs diagnosable and supportable within privacy-aware operational envelopes.

objectives.statement: Trace causal transitions and control quality, time, cost, queue, capacity, and incident response.

competencies.title: Release, interoperability, and change
competencies.description: Preserves local action semantics through bounded release, protocols, migration, replay, and retirement.

objectives.statement: Validate protocol and component changes without surrendering identity, effect, authority, or evidence contracts.

competencies.title: Technical leadership and evidence-earned reuse
competencies.description: Communicates uncertainty and promotes reusable seams only after repeated bounded evidence.

objectives.statement: Defend claims, preserve authority boundaries, and choose retain, reduce, repair, reuse, platformize, or retire.
